BiblicalUsage: Barar means to make clean, to purify, to separate the pure from the mixed. Daniel says many shall be purified and made white in the time of the end, Isaiah tells those who bear the vessels of the Lord to be clean, Zephaniah says God will turn the peoples to a pure language, and the psalm says with the pure God shows Himself pure.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe purification is God's work and our calling at once, because He cleanses and then commands us to stay clean. Daniel's purified ones are made white by trial, and I hold that the trials God sends are the fire that leaves His people pure.
